rawOutput:
1. `[blocker]` `apps/web/wrangler.jsonc:11` — `"assets": { "not_found_handling": "404-page", "run_worker_first": ["/_emdash/*"] }` routes non-`/_emdash/*` requests through static asset lookup first and terminates misses with a 404 instead of invoking the Worker — with `output: "server"` (`apps/web/astro.config.mjs:18`) and only `apps/web/src/pages/index.astro:9` prerendered, every SSR public route (`/posts`, `/posts/[slug]`, `/[slug]`, `/category/[slug]`, `/tag/[slug]`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`) bypasses the Worker and returns 404 (and `apps/web/src/pages/404.astro` is not prerendered, so `apps/web/dist/client/404.html` does not exist either).

2. `[blocker]` `apps/web/wrangler.jsonc:16` — Top-level (production) Wrangler config has placeholder Hyperdrive ID `"00000000000000000000000000000000"` and omits `kv_namespaces` for `SESSION` (present only under `env.testing` at line 52) — `@astrojs/cloudflare` auto-injects an ID-less `{"binding":"SESSION"}` into `apps/web/dist/server/wrangler.json:1`, so a production deploy fails on the invalid Hyperdrive ID and unbound `SESSION` KV namespace (without `SESSION`, admin passkey sign-in fails with `sessionUnavailableError()`).

3. `[major]` `apps/web/wrangler.jsonc:53-55` — `env.testing` declares `"durable_objects"` (`EMDASH_ROOMS` -> `EmDashRoom`) without repeating `"exports": { "EmDashRoom": { "type": "durable-object", "storage": "sqlite" } }` (lines 24–26) or any `migrations` block — as line 4 notes, Wrangler does not inherit top-level definitions into `env.*`, so deploying `--env testing` leaves `EMDASH_ROOMS` referencing a Durable Object class whose SQLite export/migration is only defined at the top level.

4. `[major]` `apps/web/package.json:12,14` — `"build": "astro build"` and `"deploy": "astro build && wrangler deploy"` omit `-c dist/server/wrangler.json` and never run `apps/web/scripts/post-build.mjs` — as documented in `apps/web/TEMPLATE_DIFF.md:37`, running `wrangler deploy` without `-c dist/server/wrangler.json` is hijacked by the legacy repo-root `wrangler.json`, and any build/deploy outside root `deploy:testing:build` skips writing `robots.txt` / `_headers` `noindex` rules into `dist/client`.

5. `[major]` `apps/web/src/middleware.ts:31-32,51-58` — `withRobots()` only sets `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` when `env.SITE_ENV` is truthy (`if (siteEnv && siteEnv !== "production")`), and the setup gate runs in Astro's user middleware after EmDash's `order: "pre"` middlewares (`emdash/middleware`, `setup`, `auth`) — if `SITE_ENV` is unset on a Worker environment, SSR responses fail open and become indexable (contradicting `apps/web/scripts/post-build.mjs:8`), and unauthenticated requests to `/_emdash/admin/setup` or `/_emdash/api/setup/*` still open a Hyperdrive Postgres connection and initialize `EmDashRuntime` before returning 404.

6. `[major]` `apps/web/package.json:18-39` & `package.json:6-8` — Version and workspace drift across the monorepo: `apps/web/package.json` specifies caret ranges `^1.5.0` for both `emdash` and `@emdash-cms/cloudflare` (while `1.6.0` is installed and `emdash` checks exact version equality at `node_modules/emdash/dist/astro/index.mjs:2166-2186`), differs from root `package.json` on `astro` (`^7.4.13` vs `7.3.3`), `@astrojs/react` (`^7.0.0` vs `^6.0.6`), `react` (`19.2.4` vs `^19.2.6`), and `wrangler` (`^4.164.0` vs `^4.132.0`), and root `package.json:6-8` `"workspaces": ["packages/*"]` omits `"apps/*"` (unlike `pnpm-workspace.yaml:1-3`) — future installs can resolve mismatched `emdash`/`@emdash-cms/cloudflare` versions and non-pnpm workspace tooling will miss `apps/web`.

7. `[major]` `apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts:4-9` — Generated `Cloudflare.Env` types still declare `MEDIA: R2Bucket` and `DB: D1Database` from the removed D1/R2 starter instead of `HYPERDRIVE`, `EMDASH_ROOMS`, `SESSION`, `SITE_ENV`, and `SETUP_TOKEN` — `apps/web/tsconfig.json:10` includes this file, so `astro check` (`apps/web/package.json:15`) type-checks against nonexistent bindings and lacks types for the actual Worker env.

8. `[major]` `apps/web/src/pages/404.astro:2` & `apps/web/src/pages/posts/index.astro:4` — Starter SSR routes (`404.astro`, `posts/index.astro`, `posts/[slug].astro`, `[slug].astro`, `category/[slug].astro`, `tag/[slug].astro`) still render `src/layouts/Base.astro` instead of `src/layouts/Global.astro`, and `404.astro` has no `export const prerender = true` — visiting any post, page, taxonomy, or 404 route drops the ported `MantineHeader`/`MantineFooter` shell, and `astro build` never emits `dist/client/404.html` for `wrangler.jsonc:11`.

9. `[minor]` `apps/web/src/components/BaseHead.astro:30` & `apps/web/public/site.webmanifest:5-14` — `<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.svg">` and the webmanifest icons (`/android-chrome-192x192.png`, `/android-chrome-256x256.png`) point to files that do not exist in `apps/web/public/` (noted for `favicon.svg` in `apps/web/PORTING.md:30`), generating 404 requests on every page load.

10. `[minor]` `apps/web/src/stores/pv.ts:28-46` — `requestAllViewCount()` awaits `_pvRequest()` without `res.ok` checking or `try/finally` resetting `pvPromise = null` — if `https://pv.growgen.xyz/pv` fails or returns non-JSON once, `pvPromise` remains non-null forever and blocks all subsequent view-count fetches in the client session.
